summary: Add local neural speech and thought-aware batching while retaining the compact brrClean denoiser.

changes.title: Silero VAD 6.2.3 and Smart Turn 3.2 INT8
changes.detail: Bundle the hash-pinned speech-activity and thought-completion models. Adaptive speech batching is enabled by default and can be disabled in Offline voice settings. Quiet boundaries can wait for thought completion, without ending the microphone session. Preserve all captured PCM, the six-second batch limit, overlap, and amplitude fallback.

changes.title: Keep lightweight GTCRN noise reduction
changes.detail: Retain the existing compact native denoiser and installed Parakeet models. Reuse the current ONNX runtime, execute neural inference on a dedicated voice worker, and verify both model graphs and APK assets in CI. Retain PCM frame bounds validation and use a host test wheel compatible with the CI runner. Permit only the exact two new auxiliary ONNX asset paths in lightweight packages, with independent SHA-256 checks; continue rejecting arbitrary ONNX and bundled Parakeet weights.
